Our client, 7 Cutz Steakhouse Newcastle Pty Ltd trading as 7 Cutz Steakhouse Newcastle, operates a premium South African-inspired steakhouse situated on the Honeysuckle waterfront in Newcastle. The restaurant is renowned for its chargrilled steaks, ribs, gourmet sides, curated drinks program and private dining experiences, delivering exceptional food and service in an elevated yet welcoming environment.

7 Cutz Steakhouse Newcastle is seeking a motivated and hands-on Cook to join its kitchen team. The successful candidate will play an integral role in supporting daily kitchen operations, preparing and cooking high-quality menu items, maintaining food safety standards and contributing to the restaurant's continued success and reputation.
This role presents an excellent opportunity for a culinary professional looking to work in a premium, steak-focused kitchen where attention to detail, consistency and a strong service mindset are highly valued.

Key Responsibilities

-	Prepare and cook a range of menu items including premium steaks, ribs, burgers, seafood and accompaniments in accordance with restaurant recipes and presentation standards.
-	Assist with daily food preparation and mise en place to ensure efficient kitchen operations during service periods.
-	Monitor food quality, portion control and presentation to ensure consistency and customer satisfaction.
-	Assist in ordering, stock rotation and inventory management while minimising food wastage.
-	Ensure food is stored, handled and prepared in accordance with food safety and HACCP requirements.
-	Maintain cleanliness and organisation of kitchen workstations, equipment and storage areas.
-	Assist with the preparation and execution of private functions and special events as required.
-	Support the Head Chef and kitchen team during busy service periods and contribute to a positive team environment.
-	Ensure compliance with all workplace health and safety (WHS) policies and procedures.

Minimum Qualifications & Experience

-	Must have at least one year of relevant experience as a Cook.
-	Certificate III or Certificate IV in Commercial Cookery or a related qualification is preferred.
-	Sound knowledge of food safety, hygiene and workplace health and safety requirements.

Skills & Attributes
-	Ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced, high-volume kitchen environment.
-	Strong organisational and time management skills.
-	Good understanding of food preparation techniques, portion control and stock management.
-	High attention to detail and commitment to quality and consistency.
-	Ability to work collaboratively as part of a team and communicate effectively.
-	Passion for hospitality and delivering exceptional dining experiences.

To apply for this position, please email your resume to recruitment@targetbusiness.com.au.

result.description:
Are you looking to advance your career as a Concrete Boom Pump Operator? We have an exciting opportunity for you to join our team in Central Queensland. Our operations are based in Rockhampton, Yeppoon, and Emerald, with proximity to mines, large civil infrastructure projects, and a wide range of pumping operations.
What We Offer:
•	Competitive Pay: Starting at $44 per hour (market salary range $80,000-$90,000 per annum), with the potential for higher rates based on experience, permanent full-time employment.
•	Ongoing Work & Plenty of Hours: A steady stream of projects means you'll always have work and hours to match.
•	Variety of Equipment: Operate a range of concrete pumps, from line pumps all the way up to 50m boom pumps, gaining hands-on experience across various equipment.
•	Accommodation for FIFO Roles: We offer accommodation for Fly-In Fly-Out (FIFO) positions, so you can work in our region while having your accommodation taken care of.
•	Flexible Rosters: We offer options such as 2 weeks on, 1 week off, so you can maintain a great work-life balance.
Key Requirements:
•	Ticketed Concrete Boom Pump Operator – Certification required + 2 years experience.
•	Current HR Truck License – Essential for operating the necessary machinery.
•	Ability to work safely and efficiently in a fast-paced environment.
•	Located in or willing to relocate to Central Queensland for ongoing projects.
•	FIFO applicants welcome – accommodation provided.
Main Duties:
•	Operate concrete pumping equipment to pump concrete.
•	Pour, spray and spread concrete over areas such as foundations, pools and retaining walls.
•	Prepare concrete pump for operation by setting up and connecting hoses, pipes and other equipment.
•	Maintain concrete pump equipment.


•	Monitor safety of the concrete boom pump and ensure worksite personnel follow relevant safety considerations in regards to the concrete boom pump.
•	Safe and effective concrete placement.
•	Co-ordinate with worksite personnel to fulfil customer requirements safely.
•	Troubleshoot machinery errors and breakdowns, with virtual or in-person support of workshop supervisor as needed.
•	Complete regular maintenance as required.
•	Report all incidents and maintenance requests as soon as possible.
•	Follow worksite and Concrete Pumping Queensland’s regulations.
•	Comply with Concrete Pumping Queensland’s code of conduct, policies and procedures.
•	Actively support fellow employees in their training and upskilling.

This is a fantastic opportunity to work in an area with plenty of ongoing infrastructure projects, alongside experienced professionals in a growing industry. Enjoy a great lifestyle in Central Queensland while operating top-of-the-line equipment!
Ready to make your next move? Apply now to secure your spot in our team!
 
We are a growing company, servicing the mining, infrastructure, and construction sectors in the beautiful Central Queensland (southern great barrier reef region.
